summary: Comprehensive architectural, workflow, and UI/UX overhaul plan for the Enquiries & Quotes module across 6 core areas: Two-tier Enquiry Detail header & split-pane layout, Enquiry List KPI strip & quick-glance indicators, interactive Line Items builder with Cost/Gross Margin % & inline editing in Enquiry Detail, Quotation Revision R1->R2 sync prompt & unified Revisions tab, unified Custom Bucket drag-and-drop RFQ attachments with Quotation Annex toggles, and multi-tenant SaaS UI/input standardization.
